findings.problem: Late SQLite handle leak after timeout: when withTimeout fires fallback, the underlying createSqliteRepositories promise may eventually resolve with an opened SQLite handle that is then discarded. No close/dispose is attempted.
findings.evidence: withTimeout ignores late settlement (settled flag) but does not cancel or close the late value; createSqliteRepositories opens DB via getDatabase() before resolving; late handle remains open but unreferenced.
findings.requiredFix: No fix required for this cycle: on degraded CI emulator the process terminates after E2E, and on healthy devices the timeout never fires (<1s). If SQLite init routinely exceeds 45s in production telemetry, add cancellation/close of late handle and metric.
findings.verification: Existing behavior before candidate discarded null on catch without close as well; no resource leak observed in 441 tests; trusted verification BUILD SUCCESSFUL with no SQLITE_BUSY warnings.
